cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our cakes tied. Blindfolded icing next; loser cleans the kitchen. You learnt to hold that piping bag from me, so let's see what stuck.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A tie is a perfectly good result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can match your teacher now. Lovely. You still have to beat me; put the blindfold by your bowl.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then no baking. We take turns describing our cakes without saying 'cake'; first one who slips cleans up. Use the precise words I taught you. You start.

reason: Make the exact Drive operate through specific prior teaching and present correction. Keep a playable action at A5, with any new contest rule and penalty explicit, and preserve the partner actual contribution.
